title.en: Gentle care for nervous companion animals

text.en: Pet owners repeatedly praise how gently cats and challenging dogs are handled throughout appointments. Several clients with anxious rescues, large breeds, and elderly animals mention that other salons turned them away, whereas Megan showed immense patience. Reviewers value the quiet, single-pet environment which prevents companion animals from becoming overwhelmed by other dogs.

title.en: Thorough baths and breed styling results

text.en: Reviews regularly mention excellent grooming outcomes, noting clean, soft coats and fresh-smelling pets following their appointments. Owners of double-coated breeds and poodles praise the precision of the haircuts and thorough de-shedding baths. Clients appreciate that grooming is executed swiftly without compromising on hygiene or finish quality.

Clients frequently commend Megan for her warm customer service, clear dedication, and attentive approach. Many reviewers note that she works efficiently whilst maintaining a calm, reassuring manner that immediately puts owners at ease. Several pet parents praise her keen eye, including catching early signs of ear infections, and highlight her willingness to accommodate individual pet requirements.

q.en: Does Megz Pet Grooming accept cats for grooming?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that Megan handles feline grooming, including nail trims and gentle baths for cats.

q.en: Can dogs with anxiety or behavioural challenges be booked?

a.en: Reviewers frequently note that Megan accommodates fearful rescues and dogs that struggled at other grooming salons.

q.en: Does the salon groom only one pet at a time?

a.en: Yes, clients appreciate the one-on-one booking model, which ensures pets are not surrounded by barking dogs or salon commotion.

q.en: Are grooming rates considered reasonable by clients?

a.en: Several reviews describe the pricing as affordable and fair given the individualized attention and high standard of care.
